
This folder contains backpack device drivers for MS-DOS.
 
Common uses for backpack under MS-DOS include:

 Using backpack as a DVD/CD-ROM under MS-DOS, reading CD-ROM and data DVD discs.
 Installing the Windows operating system from CD.
 

NOTE: Backpack MS-DOS drivers may not work with all programs from companies other than Micro Solutions.
See Micro Solutions' Web site for compatibility information.

The SETUP program in this folder can be used to install the backpack drivers on an MS-DOS boot disk to use backpack under DOS.
The batch file LOADCD.BAT can be used to load the BACKPACK drivers after MS-DOS has started.


For more information refer to Micro Solutions' Web site at www.micro-solutions.com.
At the time that this document was prepared the following Support Documents were available:

Installing Windows 95, 98 or Me from a backpack CD-ROM drive - Document 3004.
Installing Windows 2000 from a Backpack CD-ROM drive - Document 3007.
Installing Windows NT4 from a backpack CD-ROM drive - Document 3003.
Installing Windows XP from a backpack CD-ROM drive - Document 3010.
